name: branding-typography-and-colour-system-with-pencil-mascot
title: Typography and colour page with a pencil mascot and weight slider
whatItIs: A white page with a headline mixing regular sans and bold italic serif, a cartoon pencil character leaning on giant 'Helvetica Neue' type, a horizontal weight slider (Light, Regular, Medium, Bold), and a circular colour chart showing five blues with percentages around a script 'p' logo.
whatItMeans: Friendly, structured and clear; the mascot humanises the guidelines and the ring makes proportions instantly visible.
techniques: Show colour proportions as segments of a ring around the logo.
Demonstrate type weights with a draggable-style slider.
Add a cartoon mascot to lighten a technical page.
Contrast light sans with italic serif in the headline.

vocabulary.definition: A circular chart showing each colour's share.
A control showing the range of font weights.
A character used to represent a brand.
The percentage of each colour used in a brand.
